The minimum age to obtain a Pennsylvania License to Carry Firearms (gun permit) is 21, as stated by the Pennsylvania State Police and reflected in county processes [d8,d7,d5]. By contrast, federal law sets different minimum ages for purchasing firearms from licensed dealers (21 for handguns, 18 for long guns) and even weaker rules for unlicensed sales [d3]. Pennsylvania also restricts possession or transport of firearms by those under 18, with limited exceptions [d1].
